notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.6.6
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/68d2e7669099db924c217badaefc65a590002f60.pngVersion 1.5.6.6 (Server Version: 1.5.6.150 | Client Version: 2.0.0.156)
Release Date: February 20, 2025

MAJOR HIGHLIGHTS

 [NEW] Introducing Loot Quality Bonus System - Players now have a chance to obtain items with (1 or 2) bonus stats during drops
 [IMPROVEMENT] Channel Selection System has been reintegrated into the character selection screen
 [IMPROVEMENT] Collision system reworked - Players can now pass through other players while mounted or running
 [SECURITY] All client executable files are now digitally signed - This resolves previous antivirus detection issues

DUNGEONS & RAIDS
Boss Encounters

 [BALANCE] Wu Zhein

 Maximum entry level cap implemented at level 160
 Added cooldown timer between attempts
 [FIX] Black Dragon entrance requirements now properly enforced at level 65
 [FIX] Boss region boundaries adjusted for:

 Dragon Lord
 Black Dragon
 Reaper Crypt
 [BALANCE] Reaper God

 Removed "Beasts" stereotype vulnerability - Beast-type damage bonuses no longer affect Reaper God

 [BALANCE] Spider Queen

 Increased aggro range for better combat engagement
Dungeon Improvements

 [IMPROVEMENT] Naga Palace

 Level design enhanced for better gameplay flow
 Added Teleport Indicator above "Dragon God High Priest" dungeon initiator

 [IMPROVEMENT] Cursed Warlord map received comprehensive level design updates
 [BALANCE] Blue Guivres in Minotaur Fortress will no longer grant elevated HXP

CLASS CHANGES
Petrun

 [IMPROVEMENT] Blade Energy

 Enhanced HP Stealing mechanics
 Improved Hitting Power Boost effectiveness

 [NERF] Magical Armor

 Defense value has been reduced

 [NERF] Fear ability

 Defense value has been reduced
Mage

 [NERF] Lightning Summon

 Stun duration NERFED from 2.5s to 1.1s
 Added percentage-based stun bonus chance
Dorhan

 [FIX] Corrected tooltip information for a level 5 ability incorrectly showing level 35 requirement
 [FIX] Fixed Bash ability dealing damage at unintended ranges

COMBAT & ABILITIES

 [IMPROVEMENT] All buff abilities now consume mana throughout their duration
 [FIX] Fixed double damage occurrence when pressing spacebar to attack followed by quick "W" key press
 [FIX] Resolved issue with ranged archers becoming invulnerable when pulled outside spawn areas

SYSTEMS & MECHANICS

 [FIX] Hero Point cap increased from 32,767
 [FIX] Quest-related item duplication exploit resolved
 [FIX] Fixed inventory stacking issues beyond page 5 in buffgrid area
 [FIX] Storage page expansion issues resolved for pages beyond 5
 [FIX] Fixed issue allowing players to mount while dead

UI/UX IMPROVEMENTS

 [IMPROVEMENT] Character window visual design updated
 [IMPROVEMENT] Teleporter welcome window GUI redesigned
 [IMPROVEMENT] Default teleporter names now properly reflect area names
 [FIX] Loading screen tip texts now display correctly
 [FIX] Fixed stuck tooltip issue when rapidly left-clicking inventory items

WORLD & ENVIRONMENT

 [FIX] Wolf Shaman Forest

 Fixed underground spawning issue at initial teleport
 Corrected visual error causing title misalignment in world atlas

 [IMPROVEMENT] Witch Queen Boss Area

 Replaced 2x Witch Warriors with 1x Witch Warrior and 1x Savage Witch Warrior
 Reinstated Hasnail Druid for quest requirements

 [FIX] Character floating issue while descending from elevated areas resolved
 [FIX] Lost Empire area now properly requires level 65 to enter

LOCALIZATION

 [FIX] Corrected English quest texts containing 'Minimum szint'
 [FIX] Fixed Witch Queen quest description for "Kill 20 white wolves"

CLIENT & LAUNCHER

 [FIX] Patch Notes link in Laniatus Launcher now functioning properly

KNOWN ISSUES

 We are actively monitoring and working on resolving various reported issues
 Please report any bugs through our official channels

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.6.5
notes.notes:
Update 1.5.6: Awakening of Legends
February 15, 2025

Welcome, Heroes! Update 1.5.6 brings comprehensive improvements to combat mechanics, enhanced world design, competitive gameplay features, and various quality-of-life changes to enrich your journey through the realm.

HIGHLIGHTS
[NEW] Battleground Arena System
[olist]
 Revolutionary e-sports arena implementation
 Support for up to 200 players in Last Man Standing mode
 Up to 40 players in standard arena matches
 Complete team management system
 Random team matchmaking functionality
[/olist]
[MAJOR IMPROVEMENT] Combat System Overhaul
[olist]
 Enhanced NPC targeting mechanics
 Improved boss encounter dynamics
 Refined combat feedback systems
[/olist]
[ENHANCEMENT] World Design Updates
[olist]
 Comprehensive zone redesigns
 Enhanced environmental details
 Improved NPC and monster placement
[/olist]
COMBAT SYSTEMS
[FIX] Core Combat Mechanics
[olist]
 Fixed unlimited hits exploit with "SPACE" in character attack
 Resolved character attack animation stutter during auto-attack sequences
 Corrected attack combo issues with consecutive hits
 Implemented "No valid target" suppression message for server-calculated attacks
 Fixed auto-attack related issues requiring temporary removal
 Improved VFX synchronization and timing
[/olist]
[IMPROVEMENT] NPC Combat Behavior
[olist]
 Enhanced NPC focus on initial attackers
 Refined group leader threat calculations
 Improved group member threat sensitivity
 Maintained target persistence after group leader defeat
 Implemented sophisticated threat management system
[/olist]
[BALANCE] Defense System Overhaul
[olist]
 NEW FORMULA: Defense = (Dexterity × 10) + 10 + (Level ÷ 2)
 Reduced overall defense values for improved combat balance
 Adjusted scaling for better progression curve
[/olist]
[ENHANCEMENT] Boss Mechanics

 INCREASED: Knockdown duration for Harkoon and Alisa-type bosses (0.7s → 7.0s)
 IMPROVED: Wu Zhein Boss combat statistics and behavior
 ENHANCED: Boss arena navigation and targeting systems
 ADDED: Clear target zone indicators for boss encounters

CLASS ADJUSTMENTS
[FIX] Petrun Class
[olist]
 Resolved Black Orb ability's 0.83ms pre-damage delay
 Fixed ability timing calculations
 Improved damage application consistency
[/olist]
[FIX] Dorhan Class
[olist]
 Corrected Triple Slash to properly apply damage three times
 Enhanced ability synchronization
 Fixed damage calculation issues
[/olist]
[FIX] Ability Systems
[olist]
 Corrected Stunning Blade ability's 'Sword Energy' VFX at level 1
 Fixed Bravery Cape cooldown (Increased by 10 seconds)
 Resolved creature teleportation issues with specific abilities
[/olist]
WORLD CONTENT
[MAJOR IMPROVEMENT] Lost Empire
[olist]
 Complete area redesign and enhancement
 Added NPC and monster visibility to Atlas
 Improved navigation pathways
 Enhanced environmental details
[/olist]
[IMPROVEMENT] Capital Palace

 Extensive architectural improvements
 FIXED: Texture and specular ratio issues
 RESOLVED: Freeze when approaching stable area
 ENHANCED: Overall visual fidelity
 ADJUSTED: Environmental lighting

[ENHANCEMENT] Witch Queen's Area
Refined boss arena mechanics and navigation

 REMOVED: Misplaced Hasnail Druid NPC
 ADDED: Storekeeper to district castle
 FIXED: Nested monster spawning issues
 IMPROVED: Object visibility
 ADDED: Angry Forest Archer to Atlas
 INCREASED: LOD levels for better visibility

[FIX] Wolf Shaman Forest
Corrected terrain configuration issues

 REMOVED: Free portal to Witch Queen zone
 ADDED: Hunter to Atlas system
 IMPROVED: Monster pathing
 ENHANCED: Environmental consistency

[IMPROVEMENT] Specific Zone Updates

 Dark Order Temple: Adjusted level design and accessibility
 Land of the Dead: Enhanced Atlas with NPC and mob visibility
 Light Order: Implemented complete Atlas system with NPC visibility

Capital City - Zorandor:


 Fixed teleport district collisions

Cursed Warlord:

 Added mob visibility to Atlas

Minotaur Fortress:

Tutorial Island:

Spider Dungeon:

MONSTER & NPC UPDATES
[BALANCE] Enemy Adjustments
Robber Archer:

Angry Forest Archer (NEW):

ITEMS & ECONOMY

PROGRESSION SYSTEM
[BALANCE] Level Requirement Adjustments
 Mountain of the Cursed Warlord notification: Level 45 (↑5)
 Spider Catacombs notification: Level 145 (↑5)
 Zombie mob HXP cap: Level 72
 Group level difference requirement: Maximum 55 levels

[FIX] Experience Mechanics

 Corrected unauthorized HXP/HP gains from high-level maps
 Fixed experience calculation issues
 Improved level-up notification timing
 Enhanced progression tracking

BATTLEGROUND ARENA
[NEW] Comprehensive Team System

 Maximum team size: 8 players

Team leader exclusive controls:

 Registration management
 Team enrollment/un-enrollment
 Random mode selection

Automatic queue management:

 Removal upon group kick
 Level difference restrictions
 Team status tracking

[NEW] Game Modes

Last Man Standing:

 Support for up to 200 players
 Enhanced battle royale mechanics

Standard Arena Modes:

 40-player capacity
 Balanced team competition
 Various gameplay objectives

[IMPROVEMENT] Arena Management

 Enhanced queue system
 Improved team balance
 Refined matchmaking algorithm
 Updated arena boundaries

TECHNICAL
[FIX] Critical Issues

 RESOLVED: Console freezing during extended play
 FIXED: Black screen during game startup
 CORRECTED: Character respawn issues
 IMPROVED: Character switching stability
 FIXED: Game client performance issues

[OPTIMIZATION] Graphics & Performance

 IMPROVED: Visual consistency

 OPTIMIZED: Texture loading

[FIX] Miscellaneous


 Corrected elixir usage when HP/MP bars are full

KNOWN ISSUES

Note: This update is part of our Closed Beta testing phase. Your feedback is crucial for further improvements. The Battleground arena system is completely open to all players during the beta period - please try it out and share your experiences! For detailed information about the Battleground arena system, please refer to our comprehensive guide.

For details of the patch notes, check out the patch-info channel on Discord.

PlayM2M

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.5.6.3
notes.notes:
The following changes were added during today's real-time maintenance!

Character abilities


 Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Heal ability from 20 to 40 seconds.
 Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Lightning Claw ability from 15 to 20 seconds.


Optimization

 Optimized the Wolf Shaman forest.
 Optimized the Minotaur Fortress.
 Optimized the Witch Queen Forest.
 Optimized the Lost Empire
 Optimized in the Land of the Dead


Other

 Greatly increased the amount of gold you can get from your opponents (all maps)
 Wildar, Eormenor and Mino's spirit chests now have optolos.
 Optolo gear is now more likely to be available from the Naga Queen and Spider Queen chests.
 The description of the gold bar now shows its value converted to gold.
 The price of optolos has been reduced by 50%
 The Cloak of Courage is now available for trade.
 Magic stone now gives a percentage mana bonus ( 10% - 30% )
 Defense Stone now gives a percentage defense bonus ( 10% - 30% )


Battleground Arena


 Achievements in Battleground as well as trophies obtained by the character are now displayed as separate tabs in the Profile window.
 We have changed the small map that appears in the top right corner under the battlegrounds: - The entire battleground will be continuously visible. - The background of the small map can be removed using the eye icon in the top left corner.
 The elements of the group UI can now be moved, the settings UI can be unlocked and the original layout can be restored using the corresponding buttons.


Issue Fixes


 Addressed an issue where Power Hunting losses and gains were not being recorded.
 Improved the clarity of the warning text when exiting Observer mode.
 Resolved a bug that allowed players to sign up for the Battlegrounds game mode, which is currently not permitted.
 Fixed the situation where players were being placed in one of the Battleground groups even as spectators.
 Corrected the display of actual values for wins and losses in the stats GUI.
 Fixed a bug that caused an uneven distribution when creating battles.
 Continuously updated the Battleground Observer Mode leaderboard.
 Closed a gap in Wolf-Shaman and the Harbor neighborhood.
 Enhanced the mechanism that refills the lives of bosses when they no longer perceive a threat.
 Improved Movement Speed bonuses to apply in all situations.
 Addressed the issue where typing long texts in chat would hide the full text until the window was resized.
 Fixed a bug where Intelligence was not properly affecting Petrun's Disable ability.
 Resolved the conflict where two Big Warehouse bonuses could be active simultaneously.
 Corrected the damage output of Shaman staffs' 2nd hit.
 Fixed the issue where the linked inventory would sometimes shift while moving.
 Adjusted the character menu button lighting to only appear when there is a skill or stat point ready to be deployed.
 Addressed various graphical issues in the Witch Queen's area.
 Fixed instances where characters would become stuck in demon gates, not attacking, and their health would constantly replenish.
 Prevented item loss when there was insufficient space to repack items during a withdrawn trade.
 Restored the music in the Witch Queen's Realm.
 Fixed a graphical bug that caused characters' faces to shatter while in hiding.
 Improved the reliability of the online GM list, ensuring that GMs consistently appear on the list and reflect their availability accurately.
 Resolved inaccuracies in the map placement of certain quest NPCs.
 Corrected the displayed attack value for the Petrun Flame Shards ability.
 Fixed a bug in Naga Run that caused the Minotaur ghost to slide on the ground instead of walking.
 Fixed an issue where the Master of Stone Evasion stone would give Defense instead of Dodge.
 Fixed a special fix has been implemented due to the game maps loading late. (Required Steam update)
 Fixed an issue where the icons of some power stones were duplicating each other.
 Fixed an issue with getting stuck on the login screen.
 Fixed a walking issue in the capital city due to a collider calculation issue. (Arena Stairs)
 Fixed an issue that caused remnants to remain on maps after events ended.


The game is finished, but the development is far from over. More exciting innovations are coming soon! Thank you for your signals, help and patience so far. We are counting on you in the future! We wish everyone a pleasant time in the world of Magic To Master!
